selection: Merged non-merge fix commits from the last 60 days touching persistence, sync, refresh, connectors or managed facts/atoms, whose src/ hunks reverse-apply cleanly (git apply -R -3) on the wave base. Tests in the fix commit are not reverted, so the gate alone decides caught/missed.

fixes.subject: fix(refresh): recheck recovery under the worktree lock so a publisher finishing mid-probe is not refused; harden 13c
fix(sync): a drain keeps retrying admission that gave up on counter contention; document group lock order (#5984)
fix(sync): no bulk group forms while a foreground write is queued; default group budget 15 s (#5984)
fix(sync): managed sources drain one at a time under sync --all (#5984)
fix(sync): hold rows never store a declared slug; fail-closed fixtures pin sync.holds=fail (#5988)
fix(persistence): a concurrent CLI call waits for the PGLite lock instead of owner_unavailable (N5-2)
v0.60.21.0 fix(persistence): SIGTERM a stopped git child before SIGKILL so it can release index.lock (#5793)
fix(persistence): a write reaching a row that awaits its revision backfill settles as revision_backfill_pending, not storage_error (#5216)
fix(persistence): startup refresh recovery scans only interrupted rows; test admission's lazy completion
fix(connectors): retained-publication recovery waits the configured write wait instead of a fixed 5 s (#5232)
fix(atoms): invalidate earlier extractions as each retirement commits; retry identity ignores the generation
fix(repair): extractor-facts restores only onto the previewed page id
